ptxt.intxrefpoff: Air Bypass Valve Removal and Installation:K14C

servinfosub.title: Visual Inspection
servinfosub.ptxt: Check that O-ring (1) is free from damage.

servinfosub.title: Operation Check
servinfosub.ptxt: Check air bypass valve operation as follows. If faulty condition is found, replace air bypass valve.

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take the following precautions when applying negative pressure to air bypass valve may cause damage to it.

item.ptxt: Do not apply negative pressure more than –17 kPa (–0.2 kgf/cm2, –2.46 psi, –0.17 bar).
Do not apply compressed air from port [a]. Blowing air by mouth from [a] would be enough for open / close check of the valve.

s1.ptxt: Check air bypass valve (1) is closed between [a] and [b] without applying negative pressure.
Connect special tool to air bypass valve and set the tool in “VACUUM” mode.

attention3.ptxt: Before using special tool (vacuum pump gauge), read its Operator’s Manual to know how to use it.

s1.ptxt: Apply specified negative pressure of –10.67 to –2.67 kPa (–0.11 to –0.02 kgf/cm2, –1.547 to –0.387 psi, –0.1067 to –0.0267 bar) and check the passage from [a] to [b] opens.
